Type: curved arm bronze table lamp
Use: light on a side table, desk or nightstand; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: bronze finish metal, white fabric drum shade
Colors: dark bronze, white
Shape: sweeping crescent arm rising from round base, wide drum shade hanging from the top, open and sculptural
Feel: graceful, calm, sculptural
Goes with: dark wood, white walls, warm neutrals, bronze accents; contemporary or transitional rooms

product.name: Pinzon Galaxy Table Lamp, Bronze
product.description: Modern design table lamp adds artistic complement as well as utility to any décor Bronze-colored, chrome-plated base with shallow straight drum cotton shade; gold cord Requires 1 bulb up to 100 watts; UL listed; 1-way switch Some easy assembly required on arrival; other colors available Measures 28 inches high by 19 inches wide; weighs approximately 10 pounds
